summary: Loyalty bundled natively into Toast POS and now into **Toast IQ Grow** ($499/month): an AI marketing agent plus a human "Marketing Success Manager" across email, SMS, loyalty, gift cards, web, ordering and guest CRM
Pilot: restaurants with Marketing Success Managers averaged +8% sales vs. similar Toast restaurants
Toast's data: loyalty members return ~2x the rate of new guests; 86% of email orders come from returning guests
IQ Grow "on track to become the fastest product to reach $10 million in ARR" (Aman Narang, CEO)
Toast's own research finds 48% of diners prioritize being remembered over points (22%) — i.e., points-based loyalty is losing appeal
Mostly SMB-oriented; enterprise chains often keep Punchh/Paytronix
Steve Fredette — President & Co-founder: "Our vision is for the Toast IQ ecosystem to become an agentic platform that handles the heavy lifting."
Spring 2026 release: IQ Grow, **Toast Drive-Thru**, Toast Finance checking, Auto Payroll

Toast describes Loyalty as a subscription within its marketing suite and supports guest enrollment across POS, kiosk and online ordering. (Scope note: Help article describes capability, not named enterprise deployment or standalone financial performance.)
